display_name: 物理后验残差恢复网络源域原型
description: 固定盲信道与条件后验，利用反投影残差训练轻量 IQ 修正网络；仅合法 L_s 训练标签参与真值监督。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU2, source-only residual training, CPU 2 threads, TF32 disabled; 4 L_s and 4 U_s gradient preflight

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], input-only estimated-action posterior and backprojected residual; paired ground IQ, legal L_s labels and frozen F soft targets guide training
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: L_s metadata contains 6300 truth labels; only fit-ID L_s truth enters loss; no U_s truth, V or test read
data.validation_ref: 384 RX8 source holdout IDs, 64 per impaired scene, previously used in pilot; no true labels used in evaluation
data.leo_config_ref: Source cache epoch20 training, epoch19 evaluation

permissions.query_use: L_s source train labels only in optimizer; U_s truth, V and test remain inaccessible
permissions.claim_scope: Source physical IDs observed in previous channel views, RX8 same prior pilot; no independent blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Random residual corrector with identity output. Fixed blind estimator and Gaussian prior; frozen F and legal L_s labels train residual; DURA loaded only after optimization for source comparison.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Blind action SHA256 0ef60a205f785bda45f9936d519e925179dbbddeef2fd6cd285a83b02a284338 and source prior SHA256 5e35516d54d3e3d1d1749933861f290c1f87c8ffdb4b863d2f9819914135ceb9
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: One fixed pass over 4096 source train IDs, final checkpoint; fixed 384 source RX8 sample, no test or checkpoint selection.

execution.launch_owner: Codex physics posterior residual pilot GPU2 owner
execution.gpu_policy: GPU2 single owner, TF32 disabled, source-only training; real L_s/U_s gradient preflight

execution.stop_rule: Stop only for provenance or role violation, output collision, nonfinite values or technical failure; preserve partial output; never stop for low performance

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Source RX8 clean-F pseudo targets not true labels; L_s train truth used only on fit IDs. No target predictions.

rows.method: identity-initialized dilated residual CNN conditioned on posterior IQ and estimated-channel adjoint residual, L_s truth + F soft targets
rows.purpose: assess whether data-consistency-conditioned correction improves frozen blind Bayesian restoration
rows.seed_notes: fixed parent prior and RX8 cohort; source fit subset and order seed2026120655
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes
rows.budget_ref: 4096 source fit IDs, batch8 one pass; 8192 distinct prior IDs and 384 source RX8 heldout
rows.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 PYTHONPATH=/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261101-phase1-physical-rich-router-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261027-phase1-pamf-repl-shuffled-views-m16-r02-release /home/szu2070436088/.conda/envs/CVS-RFFI/bin/python -X utf8 -u /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261102-phase1-bayes-residual-pilot-s2026092701-r01-release/experiments/phase1_bayes_residual/bayes_residual_pilot.py --root /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet --out /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/runs/20261102-phase1-bayes-residual-pilot-s2026092701-r01 --commit 7580869fa8d5d048cbb5463b055b37a757debeb5 --device cuda:0

notes: L_s metadata loads 6300 labels for physical ID verification; only fit IDs L_s labels enter loss; U_s truth not loaded.

No V or Phase1 test IQ.
